name: Greg Stanton
stance: Backs AI-safeguard legislation and U.S.-China diplomacy on catastrophic AI risk.

statements.text: Congress has a critical window over the next few months to take action on AI safety.
AI safety experts are sounding the alarm. So why is Speaker Johnson sending the House home for the next six weeks?
Co-signed the 26-Democrat letter urging AI-safety diplomacy with China against catastrophic risks such as AI-enabled pathogens and cyberattacks.
We're urging @SpeakerJohnson to call the House back into session so we can pass AI safety legislation and put real guardrails in place.
Today @CmteOnCCPDems held an emergency hearing calling for a U.S.-China agreement to responsibly pace the development of AI.

review.note: added October 2026; letter signature verified via the leads' primary release
